evidence.title: Bolt AI builder: Websites, apps & prototypes
Plans & pricing: Bolt's AI powered website and app builder

name: Bolt
summary: AI builder that turns chat prompts into websites, apps and prototypes, with hosting and databases built in.
description: Bolt is an AI builder that creates websites, apps and prototypes from chat prompts. It ships templates (dashboards, storefronts, portfolios), imports design systems from GitHub, private npm registries or Storybook, and runs Bolt Cloud for hosting, custom domains, databases, auth, analytics and SEO. Plans run from Free to Pro, Teams and Enterprise.
contains: build websites and apps by chatting with AI
use cases: AI app builder, AI website builder, SaaS dev, prototyping
templates: dashboards, storefronts, portfolios to fork
Bolt Cloud: hosting, custom domains, databases, auth, analytics, SEO
design system import from GitHub, private npm registries and Storybook
plans: Free ($0, 300K tokens/day), Pro $25/mo, Teams $30 per member, Enterprise
model routing between standard and max Bolt Agent
trusted by Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, AWS, Meta, Stripe and others
